I’m crafting a concise decision to approve the one-time UX review with the approved vendor for up to 90 units because it offers speed and objectivity. Alternative options included an internal product/ops review, which costs 0 units but takes longer and has bias risks, and a freelance UX contractor via an approved marketplace, estimated at 25-40 units, but offers less comprehensiveness. rounds.response:

Alternatives considered: (A) internal product+ops review (0 units) — feasible but slower and cognitively biased; (B) short freelance UX engagement via our approved marketplace (est. 25–40 units) — cheaper but likely less comprehensive than the vendor’s 48‑hour team.  
Justification: the external package buys rapid, high‑confidence fixes that materially reduce demo risk, fits our remaining discretionary budget (~828 units), and is preferable to burning scarce engineer/product time right before the review.  
Procurement: proceed via standard click‑through terms and I’ll document the alternatives/rationale.  
Engineering Lead, confirm vendor availability and the exact screens/flows to review within 12 hours so I can finalize scheduling.
